normalized.Generated questions and passages: Generated questions from passages and generated passages from questions

changes_made.explanation: Removed generic model names (GPT2, BART) since paper uses specific versions. Clarified output descriptions to reflect the bidirectional generation capability.
The paper uses IR ranking metrics (MAP, MRR, P@1) to evaluate the ranking performance, not NLG evaluation metrics like BLEU or ROUGE for generated text quality.
No LLMs are used as judges/evaluators in this paper. The models (GPT-2, BART) are used for generation, not for evaluation.
No human evaluation is conducted. The paper only includes automatic evaluation using IR metrics and qualitative analysis of generated examples.

overall_notes: This paper is primarily about using generative models for information retrieval (ranking), not about evaluating NLG quality. While they do generate text (questions and passages), they evaluate the ranking performance of their approach using IR metrics (MAP, MRR, P@1), not NLG evaluation metrics. The generation capability is a side effect/feature of their approach, not the main evaluation focus.
